claim writer authentication, hostile-writer resistance, immutable storage, non-repudiation, digital signatures, directory-entry durability, or RFC conformance

change agent outcomes, retrieval, decision context, scenario truth, model access, MCP authority, operator authentication, approval semantics, capabilities, executor actions, or synthetic state transitions
silently repair, delete, or rewrite a missing, orphaned, stale, malformed, or mismatched trace-anchor state
change repository visibility, access, or ownership
reversible_actions: freeze and validate a project-authored live-trace-anchor contract before runtime implementation
add deterministic sibling anchor serialization, exact verification, durable file flush, fsync, and same-directory atomic replacement
run development, held-out, regression, package, real-surface, clean-clone, and release verification
version, commit, push, review, merge, publish, and verify only after every gate passes

a secret or external trust anchor becomes necessary
